## Author checklist

- [ ] The change is limited to the intended scope
- [ ] The change follows repository standards and conventions
- [ ] The controlling issue or decision is linked where applicable
- [ ] Acceptance criteria are defined and addressed
- [ ] Validation evidence is included
- [ ] Relevant documentation is updated
- [ ] Generated files are updated where required
- [ ] Debugging artefacts and temporary files are removed
- [ ] Sensitive information has not been introduced
- [ ] Public-disclosure implications have been reviewed
- [ ] Follow-up work is recorded rather than left implicit
- [ ] The pull request is ready for review

## Reviewer checklist

- [ ] The change addresses the stated purpose
- [ ] The acceptance criteria are satisfied
- [ ] Validation evidence is sufficient
- [ ] Security and information-disclosure risks have been considered
- [ ] Governance impacts have been handled
- [ ] Compatibility and migration requirements are acceptable
- [ ] Documentation is sufficient
- [ ] Remaining work is explicitly recorded
